# Naaman Returns with Thanks

## Emotional Focus
Thankfulness after God heals — mercy is a gift, not something we buy.

## Key KJV
And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel… And he said unto him, Go in peace. — 2 Kings 5:15, 19 (KJV)

## Gentle Retelling
After Naaman was clean in the Jordan, he came back to Elisha with a glad and thankful heart. He said he knew the true God was in Israel, and he wanted to give a gift. Elisha would not take silver or clothes — the healing was God’s free gift. Naaman asked for a little earth to remember the LORD, and Elisha sent him home with kind words: Go in peace.

## Coloring Prompt
Naaman and his friends standing thankfully before Elisha; simple house, calm faces, no scary disease marks, thick kid-friendly outlines for coloring.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
God’s mercy is a gift — a thankful heart is a beautiful offering.
